```cypher
MATCH (p:Plugin {component: 'mod_dialogue'})
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:MAINTAINS]->(m:Maintainer)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[s:SUPPORTS]->(r:MoodleRelease)
WITH p, COLLECT(DISTINCT m.display_name) AS maintainers, COLLECT(DISTINCT r) AS supportedReleases
WHERE ANY(rel IN supportedReleases WHERE toFloat(rel.release) >= 3.9)
RETURN p.component, p.name,
       maintainers,
       p.last_release_ts,
       [rel IN supportedReleases WHERE toFloat(rel.release) >= 3.9 | rel.release] AS supported_moodle_releases
ORDER BY p.component
LIMIT 100
```
